bio: Indulge in an Afternoon Tea at Skeabost House Hotel in a historic and elegant victorian mansion overlooking Loch Snizort.  Afternoon Tea is served in the cosy lounge or in the conservatory with picturesque views over the loch.  The menu features a selection of hand-cut sandwiches, homemade scones with cream, and a selection of cakes and shortbreads all served on a platter. Afternoon Tea can be upgraded with a glass of prosecco for an additional £5.  Skeabost House Hotel is close to historical landmarks including St.Columba's Isle and is within close proximity to Portree.
